subject: MAP onramp: acceptance cadence, dataset handoff, and limited-use pack
messages:
From: Claire Simmons <claire@lumera.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-13T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot MAP + dataset handoff question

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We are ready to move forward with a small pilot focused on search relevance. Before we kick off, the evaluation team asked for a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a way to exchange a small prompt/testcase pack so we can validate locally.

High level: Lumera will provide a 2k-item prompt pack (sample testcases) and a small model-agnostic evaluation harness. We need Redwood to:
- Confirm acceptance criteria (A/B improvement thresholds + regression guardrails)
- Provide ephemeral staging access for evaluation (30-day window)
- Commit to a take-down and destruction timetable after the pilot

I attached a zipped sample of the pack (lumera_promptset_v1.zip) and can share a fuller MAP draft if that helps. Can you confirm Redwood’s standard constraints for exchanged evaluation assets (retention, non-derivative language, watermarking)? Also: we prefer data exchange over a secure transfer (SFTP or pre-signed GCS) — what’s your recommended flow?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Simmons
Head of Evaluation, Lumera AI
Attachments: lumera_promptset_v1.zip (zip, 2.1 MB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire@lumera.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-13T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + dataset handoff question

Hi Claire — great to hear and thanks for sending the sample.

We can support the pilot and the flow you describe. Proposed MAP (high level) and commitments from Redwood:
1) Acceptance cadence
   - Week 0: dataset delivery and staging access
   - Week 1: baseline run (your harness) + shared eval metrics
   - Week 2: model tuning/quantization iteration (if needed)
   - Week 3: final A/B evaluation and sign-off
   - Sign-off criteria: observed +5% mean reciprocal rank (MRR) or no more than 1% drop on precision@10 versus baseline; automatic rollback if regression on guardrail tests

2) Asset handling and limits
   - Ephemeral staging access: 30-day access window; automatic credential expiry
   - Retention: Redwood will retain exchanged assets only for the 30-day evaluation window unless we agree to a longer term in writing
   - Non-derivative clause: Redwood will not redistribute or build derivative datasets; model artifacts derived from run-time outputs are permitted for debugging under NDA

3) Transfer and security options
   - Preferred: pre-signed GCS link delivered to a secure Redwood transfer inbox (we can create a dedicated bucket and time-limited link)
   - Alternative: SFTP with ephemeral account

4) Operational support
   - Weekly 30-minute syncs during the campaign; on-call infra contact for transfer issues

I’m looping in Laura (legal) and Ben (sales/CS) to confirm legal wording for the MAP and to scope any pricing/credits for the pilot. I’ll also attach a short MAP draft (MAP-draft-v1.pdf) with the timeline above and a checklist for delivery.

Next steps: can Lumera confirm delivery format for the full 2k pack (CSV vs JSONL), and we’ll schedule the Week 0 handoff for the week of Jan 11.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Simmons <claire@lumera.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + dataset handoff question

Thanks for the context. A few legal/security guardrails we should memorialize in the MAP draft before transfer:

- Purpose-limited license: Lumera grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the prompt/testcase pack solely for the accepted pilot evaluation and related debugging.
- Retention & destruction: Redwood confirms automated deletion 30 days after the staging window end; we will provide a deletion log within 7 days of deletion completion.
- Prohibition on redistribution: Redwood will not publish, resell, or otherwise redistribute the raw testcases. Outputs from model runs may be used for internal model quality analysis but cannot be shared externally without Lumera’s written consent.
- Watermarking & provenance: if Lumera includes provenance tokens we will preserve them in outputs when displaying example failures.
- Audit evidence: we can provide access logs and a transfer receipt; however, SOC2-type evidence will require a formal request via our security review process.

Ben — can you confirm any pilot credit or discount we’re comfortable offering (if Lumera asks) and whether CS will run the Week 1 baseline?

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Simmons <claire@lumera.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-15T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + dataset handoff question

Thanks Laura — that aligns with our expectations. Quick clarifications from Lumera:
- Format: full 2k pack will be provided as JSONL (one testcase per line) plus a small manifest CSV that maps IDs to test types.
- Watermarking: we include a non-visible provenance token in the JSONL id field. Keeping that intact is fine.
- Deletion log: confirmed, please include a timestamp and the storage key for each deleted object.
- Audit evidence: we likely won’t require SOC2 artifacts for a pilot, but we may ask for access logs and a signed receipt.

I’ve attached the sample pack we used in the demo (lumera_promptset_v1.zip) — that contains the JSONL sample and a short README. We propose Week 0 transfer on 2027-01-11 and Week 3 sign-off on 2027-02-01 (dates inclusive).

Claire
Attachments: lumera_promptset_v1.zip (zip, 2.1 MB)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire@lumera.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-16T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + dataset handoff question

Claire — all good on our side. Confirming the MAP and operational milestones as final for the pilot:

- Week 0 (2027-01-11): Redwood creates a dedicated GCS transfer folder and provides a pre-signed link to Claire; Lumera uploads the JSONL bundle + manifest.
- Week 1 (2027-01-18): Redwood CS runs baseline with Lumera harness; we share run logs and metric snapshots in the shared Drive folder.
- Week 2 (2027-01-25): Tuning iteration and one follow-up run.
- Week 3 (2027-02-01): Final A/B evaluation and sign-off; if the pass criteria are met we schedule a short readout with the product team.

Operational notes:
- Access window: 30 days from 2027-01-11; credentials expire 2027-02-10 23:59 UTC.
- Deletion: Redwood auto-deletes staging objects 7 days after credential expiry and will provide a deletion log within 7 days of that action.
- Evidence: we will upload transfer receipts and access logs to the Drive folder and can export them if Lumera needs a signed copy.

Ben — please add the pilot as a pending credit conversation if Lumera asks for promotional pricing; CS run is owned by Ben and team.

Claire — thanks again. If that aligns I’ll convert MAP-draft-v1.pdf to a signed MPA addendum and share the final link for the transfer folder.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: (none)
